description: Angular response of three detectors relative to an ionization chamber (Excel line chart with circle markers; blue PTW 60019, orange PTW 60023, red SN Edge) vs gantry angle -60..60 deg, deviations +4 % .. -12 %. The X axis line runs through the middle of the plot at 0 % with its labels just below it; the Y axis line is the left edge at -60 deg. No tick marks on either axis; light-grey gridlines at every labelled value. Journal figure (Chea et al. 2024, Radiat Oncol 19:40, Fig. 10 panel a; crop x 0-980, y 0-642 of the publisher's 1960x642 PNG), 980x642 PNG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow/NumPy/SciPy): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the horizontal axis line at 0 % (grey ~190, 2-3 px, darker than the gridlines ~217), in the middle of the plot; labels -60 ... 60 sit just below it (rows 186-200), crossed by the curves. No tick marks: tick px are the vertical gridline centres (the -60 one is the Y axis line). The rendering is not exactly affine: gridlines AND markers at -60..-30 sit 2 px right of the line through the others (spacing 141 px between -40 and -20, 143 px elsewhere).

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the vertical axis line at -60 deg (grey ~190). No tick marks: tick py are the horizontal gridline centres, values in percent (labels carry a "%" suffix: "4%" ... "-12%"). The -12 % gridline is drawn at row 631.48, 2 px below the value position 629.4 given by the other gridlines and by its own label centre (628.75); the label is used.

knownValues.description: Blue marker at 60 deg, lower half under the "60" label (text: -0.5 %)
Blue marker at -60 deg, on the top gridline (text: +4 %; pixels 3.95 %, 1.9 px)

markerNotes: Markers are 13 px circles at every 10 deg, joined by 3 px lines of their own colour, drawn blue, then orange, then red on top. Centres of clean markers: centroid of the colour after a 3 px opening; partly hidden ones (blue at -40, -30, -20, -10, 40, 60; orange at -50, -10, 20) by matching the visible half of a clean marker of the same colour (+/- 1 px; blue at -20 shows only its lower rim, +/- 2 px). Not listed because fully hidden under the red marker: blue and orange at 0 deg (all three series are 0 % at 0 deg by construction).
pitfalls: The X axis line is at 0 % in the middle of the plot (axis-through-middle); its labels -60 ... 60 sit just below it inside the plot, where the curves cross them; the blue markers at 40 and 60 deg are partly covered by the "40" and "60" labels.
No tick marks on either axis (Excel default): only gridlines and labels.
Y labels carry a "%" suffix ("4%", "-12%"); minus signs are short hyphen-like dashes.
The bottom gridline (row 631.48) is 2 px below the -12 % value position (629.4); x positions -60..-30 are 2 px right of an affine fit through the rest (both in the source image).

A three-entry legend with line+marker samples sits inside the plot at the bottom left (rows ~500-620, columns 130-370), over the gridlines; "Angle (deg)" axis title inside the plot at the top right of the 0 % line; panel title "MRIdian (a)" inside the plot at the top.
All three series meet at (0, 0 %); blue/orange/red markers overlap at -40 ... -10 deg.
